distribution.narrative: Sittichaya et al. (2024) described Eccoptopterus formosanus from Nantou County, Taiwan, with type material from Ren’ai and Lugu townships. Taiwan occurrence is therefore confirmed; no mainland-China occurrence is reported in this source.

host_note: The original description and biology section explicitly report breeding from five host species in Taiwan: Elaeocarpus sylvestris, Lithocarpus hancei, Quercus glauca, Sapium discolor and Trema orientale. These are promoted as confirmed current hosts.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Eccoptopterus formosanus Lin, Sittichaya & Smith, 2024.

taxonomic_history.name: Eccoptopterus formosanus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Eccoptopterus formosanus Lin, Sittichaya & Smith was described as a new species in 2024. The original-description evidence maps directly to pre-existing integrated taxonomic backbone identity VSN_2488; no duplicate VSN is created. The Thailand-only E. intermedius is outside this China checklist entry.
